## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line brand is expanding its Procurement team in the USA. Reporting to the MSC USA Procurement Manager, the Purchasing Agent is responsible for managing transactional procurement requests, including purchase order creation, order tracking, and timely processing of requisitions.

This role monitors delivery status and provides timely updates to stakeholders, while collaborating with the Sourcing, Logistics, Planning and Product teams to ensure the proper execution of the ordering process.

The Purchasing Agent also liaises with shipboard personnel to support efficient ordering and loading operations for U.S.-based vessels and MSC Ocean Cay.
This is a hybrid position requiring employees to work from the Miami office four days per week (Monday through Thursday), with the option to work remotely on Fridays.

* Review requisitions (RDA) received from shipboard personnel prior to purchase order creation.
* Create purchase orders and monitor order status throughout the purchasing lifecycle.
* Report shortages and delays to the Procurement Manager to support corrective action and local sourcing when required.
* Provide ongoing support for contracted and non-contracted purchasing requests.
* Follow up with suppliers on deliveries prior to vessel loadings.
* Reconcile invoices and resolve discrepancies related to goods received and payment issues.
* Resolve supplier issues related to delays and discrepancies in accordance with Procurement procedures.
* Maintain accurate and current information within the Company-s ERP, Procurement e-Platform and Discrepancy Reports.
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Logistics, Planning, Product and shipboard teams to support efficient ordering and loading operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve service levels, reduce order processing costs and lead times, minimize supply chain waste and support cost-reduction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with applicable U.S. federal laws and MSC policies and procedures.
## Your Journey so far ##
* College degree required, preferably in Finance, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* 2-3 years of purchasing experience; cruise line industry experience is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
